passes.reasoning: G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with the label-free fixed agreement threshold at the same call budgets. The baseline has no free labels, so it has no information advantage. Greedy trails fixed by 23.2 pp at 5% and 8.8 pp at 10%, and ties it at 25% and 50%. The seed sd is about 1 pp, so the interval does not favor the learned arm. L7a repeats this at equal labels. That gives not_supported, and the free-label confound is controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, the only embedding AUC and neighbor-ratio numbers (gain -0.001, ratio about 1.0) are from E01. Every later run uses the same GSM8K, Qwen and majority-vote setup, and the prompt-space follow-ups never ran. The kill condition is not met, so claim 3 is open. The ledger does not hold claim 3 as supported, so W3 is false.

G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with the fixed and recal thresholds at matched budget. Neither baseline gets free labels. Greedy minus fixed is -23.2 pp at 5% and -8.8 pp at 10%, and ties at 25% and 50%. Later equal-label runs (L7a, L9b) also put the learned arm below the frozen table. That meets the not_supported conditions, and the confound is controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, E01 is the only entry reporting embedding AUC and neighbor ratio. Every later entry uses the same model, task and proxy, and none reports embedding gains. The prompt-space tests (L2c, L7c) were never run, so there is no qualifying non-E01 kill and claim 3 stays open. The ledger does not call it supported, so W3 is false.

G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with label-free fixed and recal thresholds at the same verifier-call budgets. Neither baseline has free labels. Greedy minus fixed is -23.2 pp at 5% and -8.8 pp at 10%, and about 0 at 25% and 50%. Greedy minus recal is -25.6, -2.6, +0.9 and 0.0 pp. No budget favors the learned arm. L7a repeats this at equal labels, with the learned arm 2 to 3 pp below the frozen table. That makes claim 2 not_supported, and the free-label confound was controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, only E01 reports embedding AUC and neighbor ratio. No non-E01 entry on a different model, task or proxy reports them, so the kill condition is unmet and claim 3 stays open. The ledger does not assert claim 3 as supported, so W3 is false.
